patterns.reminder: Possible secret/key material in a log call. Never log a mnemonic, private key, seed, PIN, or a *_SECRET/JWK env value — logs can leave the device. Log an opaque id or a fixed marker instead.

The Worker must never write the pk allowlist cache. Every pk:* / writeAllowCache write belongs inside InviteManager under blockConcurrencyWhile (serialized owner) — an unserialized worker get→put can resurrect a revoked key.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to '*'. CORS must reflect an origin only when it is in ALLOWED_ORIGINS — never wildcard, and never add *.pages.dev preview domains to the prod allowlist.
Arweave calls must use https. A plaintext http:// endpoint exposes upload traffic to tampering.
